name: Shipvela
description: Create website projects, deploy supported GitHub repositories, and read deployment status, build logs and usage.

auth.instructions: Create or sign in to a Shipvela account, then authorize through the client browser flow using OAuth S256 PKCE. GitHub deployments require an existing Shipvela GitHub connection; publishing consumes allowance (Hobby starts free with 3 projects and 20 publishes/month, paid plans available).
